Maze Generator

Make a printable maze with one path from the top-left opening to the bottom-right opening.

Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is uploaded.

The maze will show up here.

Width and height are 5 to 100 cells. The same seed always makes the same maze. 100 by 100 is the largest.

How to use

  1. Set Width, Height, and Seed, or press "Easy", "Medium", or "Hard".

  2. Press "New maze" for a different maze. Press "Show solution" to see the path.

  3. Press "Print" for the maze and the answer, or "Download PNG" or "Download PDF" to save a file.

Example

A teacher, Riley, needs a 10 by 10 maze for class and writes down seed 12345 so the same sheet can be printed again.

BeforeAfter
 
10 by 10, seed 12345
One path from the top-left opening to the bottom-right opening.

FAQ

Why does the same seed look the same later?

The maze is built from that seed, not from a fresh random draw. Type the same width, height, and seed to get the same maze.

Where do I start?

Enter at the opening in the top-left cell. Leave through the opening in the bottom-right cell. There is only one path.

Can I print the answer too?

Yes. Press Print. The maze is on the first page and the answer path is on the next page, without the site header.

What if I type a size that is too big?

Use a width and height from 5 to 100. Press Easy, Medium, or Hard to fill in a size that works.
